[P2] Recheck termination before delayed attempt callbacks

This check runs only at operation entry. If `waitForCondition`'s initial-state deserializer finishes after the deadline, `executeCheckLogic()` resumes, submits its non-awaited `START` to the terminating checkpoint manager, and still invokes `check()`. This starts fresh polling work after the wrapper has returned; the check callback has no abort signal. Check termination again before invoking the attempt callback after asynchronous preparation, leaving the operation unresolved when terminated. Add a composed regression that holds initial-state deserialization across the deadline and verifies that `check()` never runs.
